desc:
👍 LIKE THE GAME FOR MORE MAPS 👍

⚡ Every step you take gives +1 Jump Power!
🏃 Run, leap, and climb your way through a massive tower!
🔥 Train your speed and unlock huge multipliers to get stronger even faster!
🏆 Race your friends and compete against other players!
👑 Climb the leaderboard and become the FASTEST player on the server!
💥 But be careful... one bad jump can send you all the way back to the start! 😨

🎧 ASMR vibes included!
Smooth movement, satisfying keyboard clicks, creamy visuals, and relaxing sounds for a perfect mix of speed & chill ✨
